notes: Appends the element from the main world, so the page's CSP applies; waits for a URL's load or inline JavaScript to run, modules included. Returns a scoped JSHandle of the element, not an ElementHandle; a CSP refusal fails with RefusedByPolicy and a URL that doesn't load with ResourceFailed.

audit.scope: Public declarations and implementation inspected; capability comparison preserves the notes on waiting, errors and identity.
